contexts.text: Such do not know what it is to grieve on this account, that they are deprived of truths; they believe that anxiety is possible only because one is deprived of the goods of the body and the world. But they who are able to be reformed... come into anxiety when they are deprived (of good and truth).
All anxiety and grief is from this source, that one is deprived of those things which he loves...
They believe that if they were deprived (of cupidities and persuasions), nothing of life would be left. AC 3938:4.
The inversion and privation of the life of truth from self. Signified.
To kill Jacob his brother = to deprive truth of life from self. AC 3610.

When they who are in such affection of truth are deprived of this life, they then first receive life... But they who are in the affection of self and the world, believe... that if they were deprived of that life, they would not live at all... When yet the case is, that when they are deprived of that life, namely, of the affection of self and of the world, life flows in from the Lord...
That good had the disposition of inverting the state, and of depriving truth of life from itself. Signified, Explained.
I perceived from the... privation of affection, that such Societies were present.
They are deprived of all intelligence...
There shall be seven years of famine = the apparent lack and privation of truth.
How the case is with the desolation of the Natural, or with the privation of truth there. Explained.
They are kept in the fear... of the deprivation of possessions in that region of Heaven...
Lest they should abuse the truths of faith, they are deprived of them...
Straitness of spirit = anxiety on account of the deprivation of the truth which is of faith, and of the good which is of charity, and a consequent state near to despair.
When they suppose themselves to be deprived of the truths and goods of faith and charity, such are affected as with the death agony...
The three degrees of the taking away and deprivation of the influx of truth and good. Signified.
By such degrees, the evil in the other life are deprived of the understanding of truth and good.
Thou shalt not vivify = the deprivation of spiritual life.
Those deprive themselves of spiritual life who conjoin to the truths of faith falsities from the evil of self-love.
I will kill you with the sword = that they will deprive themselves of good and truth by means of falsities.

When nakedness regards the head, which is baldness, it = the deprivation of intelligence of truth and wisdom of good; when it regards the whole body, it = the deprivation of the truths which are of faith; and when it regards the loins and genitals, it = the deprivation of the good of love. Explained.
Night = the deprivation of love and wisdom.
As soon as this is done, the Angel is deprived of his intelligence and wisdom.
They come into the delight of their concupiscence from the deprivation and removal of heavenly delight with those who are in it.
They deprive all others of their delight...
The deprivation of all the good and thence of all the truth from the Word, and thence in their doctrine of the Church from the Word. Signified.
To kill = to deprive of good and truth.
They who are in evils and falsities, deprive themselves of all the perception of good and of the understanding of truth from the Word, and thence in their doctrine of the Church. Explained.
Hunger = the privation of the Knowledges of truth and good, also the lack and ignorance of them.

It is said that hunger = the deprivation of the Knowledges of truth and good, also the lack and ignorance of them, because deprivation exists with those who are in evils and thence falsities, lack with those who are not able to know them, and ignorance with those who know there are such things and therefore long for them.
The deprivation of all truth and thence of all good. Signified.
Famine = the deprivation of the Knowledges of good... the sword, the deprivation of the Knowledges of truth...
The sword = the deprivation of truth by means of falsities; famine, the deprivation of good by means of evils; and pestilence, the deprivation of spiritual life. AE 8.
Spiritual life is extinguished by means of perversions of good and falsifications of truth; also by means of deprivations of the Knowledges of truth and good...
The deprivation of all truth on account of recession. Signified.
The signs of the presence of such are... the deprivation of the perception of good...
